WITH status_counts AS (
  SELECT
    powerstatus,
    COUNT(*) AS telescope_count,
    COUNT(*) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS share_pct
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY powerstatus
),
status_shares AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    AVG(share_pct) OVER () AS average_share_pct
  FROM status_counts
)
SELECT
  SUM(telescope_count) AS total_telescope_count,
  AVG(share_pct) AS average_share_pct,
  AVG(share_pct - average_share_pct) AS average_excess_share_pct
FROM status_shares
WHERE share_pct > average_share_pct;
